name: Google Workspace - Account deactivation notice (staff)
subject: Your corporate account @{{ object.env.company.google_ws_domain }} will be deactivated
body_html:
Hello ,

Now that you are no longer part of the school staff, your corporate Google Workspace account is scheduled to be deactivated on .

Until that date the account keeps working normally. Please make sure you have saved anything you need from your email and your Drive files before then, and that you have moved any personal service using this address to another one.

If you come back to the school before that date, the account is kept and nothing is lost.

Best regards,
School Secretariat

body_html:
Hello ,

Now that you are no longer enrolled at the school, your corporate Google Workspace account is scheduled to be deactivated on .

Once deactivated, the account is deleted for good on . After that date your email and your Drive files cannot be recovered.

You can use your account as usual before ; from (included) you will no longer be able to access it; on it will be deleted for good. Please make sure you download everything you want to keep before then, and that you have moved any personal service using this address to another one.

If you enrol again at the school before those dates, the account is kept and nothing is lost.

Best regards,
School Secretariat
